user.title: Set up Robotix Home Intelligence - Mobility Module
user.description: Publishes Mobility build specifications, consumes Foundation-selected build input, exposes canonical Mobility Public Runtime V2, Energy V2 and safe Mobility-owned controls. No command runs automatically at startup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Robotix Home Intelligence - Mobility Module is already configured.

init.title: Mobility settings
init.description: Choose what you want to configure. Everyday vehicle and charger settings are kept separate from profiles and technical overrides.

edit_product_asset.title: Mobility settings › Configure {asset}
edit_product_asset.description: Configure this concrete asset. Profile-owned technical product facts remain inherited unless you explicitly use Advanced overrides.

data_description.asset.profile_id: Choose a product profile or leave it automatic so exact product identity can resolve the profile.
data_description.vehicle.battery_capacity_kwh: Overrides the selected vehicle profile for this concrete vehicle only.
data_description.vehicle.max_ac_power_kw: Overrides the profile maximum AC charging capability for this vehicle only.
data_description.vehicle.phase_capability: Overrides the profile AC phase capability for this vehicle only.
data_description.charger.min_current_a: Overrides the profile minimum controllable current for this charger only.
data_description.charger.max_current_a: Overrides the profile maximum current for this charger only.
data_description.charger.max_power_kw: Overrides the profile maximum power for this charger only.
data_description.charger.phase_capability: Overrides the profile phase capability for this charger only.
data_description.charger.nominal_voltage_v: Overrides the profile nominal voltage for this charger only.
data_description.charger.current_step_a: Overrides the profile current adjustment step for this charger only.
data_description.vehicle.selected_charger: Choose the charger assigned to this vehicle. The UI shows its human display name; the backend persists the stable asset id.

add_vehicle_profile.title: Add custom vehicle profile
add_vehicle_profile.description: Add one vehicle model that is not already in the verified catalog. Use exact product identity and real technical specifications.

data_description.display_name: Human-readable product name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.short_name: Compact label for cards and constrained views.
data_description.brand: Manufacturer brand, for example Audi, BMW or Volkswagen.
data_description.model: Product model, for example Q8 or i4.
data_description.variant: Exact derivative/trim needed to distinguish the product.
data_description.model_year: Model year used as part of the exact catalog identity.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable/authoritative battery capacity for this product profile.
data_description.phase_capability: Number of AC phases supported by the vehicle.

add_charger_profile.title: Add custom charger profile
add_charger_profile.description: Add one charger model that is not already in the verified catalog. Use exact product identity and electrical limits.

data_description.display_name: Human-readable product name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.short_name: Compact label for cards and constrained views.
data_description.model_year: Optional model year where it materially distinguishes the hardware.
data_description.min_current_a: Lowest current the charger can reliably request.
data_description.nominal_voltage_v: Nominal AC voltage used for the product profile.

edit_selected_profile.title: Edit {name}
edit_selected_profile.description: Edit the selected product directly. Save returns to the searchable profile catalog so you can continue with the next product.

data_description.display_name: Human-readable product name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.short_name: Compact label for cards and constrained views.
data_description.brand: Manufacturer brand, for example Audi, BMW or Volkswagen.
data_description.model: Product model, for example Q8 or i4.
data_description.variant: Exact derivative/trim needed to distinguish the product.
data_description.model_year: Model year used as part of the exact catalog identity.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable/authoritative battery capacity for this product profile.
data_description.phase_capability: Number of AC phases supported by the vehicle.

remove_selected_profile.title: Remove {name}
remove_selected_profile.description: A profile can only be removed when no Mobility asset or guest vehicle uses it.

add_guest_vehicle.title: Add guest vehicle
add_guest_vehicle.description: Create a Mobility-owned vehicle without a Foundation technical device. Start from a known vehicle profile or enter a custom product.

edit_guest.title: Edit guest vehicle
edit_guest.description: Change the guest name or switch between a known vehicle profile and a custom product.

remove_guest.title: Remove {name}
remove_guest.description: Remove this guest vehicle and its Mobility-owned configuration.

vehicle_profile_config.title: Mobility settings › Advanced › Vehicle profiles
vehicle_profile_config.description: Manage vehicle product profiles. The list is sorted by brand and searchable by brand, model, variant or year. Profile values are product defaults; concrete vehicles can override permitted values in Vehicle config.

data_description.action: Edit, add, remove/disable, or restore a profile.
data_description.profile: Profiles are displayed as Brand — Model · Variant · Year so products from the same brand stay together.

charger_profile_config.title: Mobility settings › Advanced › Charger profiles
charger_profile_config.description: Manage charger product profiles. The list is sorted by brand and searchable by brand, model, variant or year. Profile values are product defaults; concrete chargers can override permitted values in Charger config.

data_description.action: Edit, add, remove/disable, or restore a profile.
data_description.profile: Profiles are displayed as Brand — Model · Variant · Year so products from the same brand stay together.

add_guest_product.title: Guest vehicle — known product
add_guest_product.description: Choose a vehicle profile and configure instance values. Manual SoC/energy values are allowed because the guest has no OEM source.

add_guest_custom.title: Guest vehicle — custom product
add_guest_custom.description: Enter the product identity and manual vehicle state for a guest without a catalog profile.

edit_guest_product.title: Edit guest — known product
edit_guest_product.description: Edit the guest product and its manual state. Manual SoC/energy is valid here because the guest has no OEM runtime source.

edit_guest_custom.title: Edit guest — custom product
edit_guest_custom.description: Edit the custom guest identity and manual state.

edit_product_asset_advanced.title: Mobility settings › Advanced › Overrides for {asset}
edit_product_asset_advanced.description: Optional explicit deviations from the selected product profile. Blank means inherit the profile value; clearing an existing override returns to profile truth.

restore_profile.title: Restore profile
restore_profile.description: Choose a disabled packaged profile to restore.

vehicles.title: Mobility settings › Vehicles
vehicles.description: Choose one connected vehicle to configure. Save finishes this vehicle task.

chargers.title: Mobility settings › Chargers
chargers.description: Choose one charger to configure. Save finishes this charger task.

guest_vehicles.title: Mobility settings › Guest vehicles
guest_vehicles.description: Choose one guest-vehicle task. Guest vehicles are Mobility-owned and do not require a Foundation technical device.

advanced.title: Mobility settings › Advanced
advanced.description: Profiles and explicit technical overrides live here. Normal vehicle and charger settings do not require this section.

advanced_vehicle_overrides.title: Mobility settings › Advanced › Vehicle overrides
advanced_vehicle_overrides.description: Choose a vehicle whose profile-owned technical values you explicitly want to override.

advanced_charger_overrides.title: Mobility settings › Advanced › Charger overrides
advanced_charger_overrides.description: Choose a charger whose profile-owned technical values you explicitly want to override.

error.invalid_product_configuration: The Mobility product configuration is invalid for this vehicle or charger.
error.unknown_product_asset: The selected Mobility asset no longer exists.
error.invalid_profile: The Mobility profile values are invalid.
error.unknown_profile: The selected Mobility-authored profile no longer exists.
error.profile_in_use: This profile is still assigned to a Mobility asset or guest vehicle.
error.invalid_guest_vehicle: The guest vehicle values are invalid. Battery energy cannot exceed capacity and SoC must be between 0 and 100%.
error.unknown_guest_vehicle: The selected guest vehicle no longer exists.
error.profile_required: Choose a profile for this action.
error.profile_not_disabled: The selected profile is not disabled.
error.guest_vehicle_required: Choose a guest vehicle for this action.
